summary: Iteration-4 testing: Prime Directives, Voice-biometric Speaker Recognition (enroll/identify/list/delete), per-person memory, Settings modal 3-tabs. Backend: 5/5 new iteration4 tests + 24/24 regression all green (29/29 total). Frontend: 8/8 UI checks passed end-to-end via Playwright with admin@promethius.ai.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now ~1136 lines — still a single module. Recommend splitting into routers (auth/chat/voice/speakers/directives/image/video/tools/scheduled/memory/vault/projects/journal/admin). Same recommendation since iteration-2.
Speakers list endpoint correctly strips embeddings (large vectors) from JSON, prevents leaking voiceprints to UI.
DELETE /api/speakers/{sid} also deletes that speaker's tagged memories — correct cascade. Good.

GET /api/directives semantics: is_default true ONLY when no doc was ever set. Once any custom value is saved (even matching the default text), is_default returns false permanently — acceptable but documented.
wav_embedding rejects < 0.5s audio (returns None) — good guard; identify with unreadable WAV returns {speaker:null, score:0} (200 OK), graceful.
build_system_prompt prepends '=== PRIME DIRECTIVES ===' block — confirmed obeyed end-to-end (a directive 'Always call the user Commander' caused the model to begin replies with 'Commander').

extract_and_store_memory correctly scopes by speaker (separate per-person memory), verified by isolation test: an astronomy fact for 'Sarah' was stored with speaker tag and did NOT leak into owner-scope memories.
SPEAKER_THRESHOLD=0.88 chosen well: synthetic same-seed 180Hz harmonic WAVs scored above threshold (matched), 420Hz different speaker scored below (null) — recognition discriminates.
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/iteration4_test.py (new — 5 tests: directives default+custom+chat-obeys, fresh-user defaults, speaker enroll/re-enroll/identify same+different/list/delete, per-person memory isolation, anthropic chat regression)
seed_data_creation: Tests are fully self-cleaning: TEST_-prefixed speakers deleted after each test, transient conversations deleted, directives restored to pre-test content, per-speaker memories removed via DELETE /api/speakers/{id} cascade. One residual: TestDirectives.test_fresh_user_directives_default creates a one-time TEST_dir_<ts>@promethius.ai user (no delete endpoint exists for users — same as iteration_2 pattern).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Four backend test files: backend_test.py (regression 24 tests ~12s), iteration2_test.py (advanced abilities ~110s), iteration3_test.py (orb-mode 5 tests ~8s), iteration4_test.py (this iteration: 5 tests ~18s — directives, speakers, per-person memory). To run new + regression: `pytest /app/backend/tests/iteration4_test.py /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py -v --tb=short`. Speaker tests generate synthetic 16kHz mono PCM WAVs with sine harmonics + tiny noise — DO NOT replace with pure sine waves (MFCC variance becomes near-zero and identify may misclassify). Live microphone / Web Speech API cannot be exercised headless. Settings modal: data-testid='voice-settings-modal', tabs settings-tab-{voice,directives,people}, directives-input + save-directives-button, person-<id>/remove-person-<id>, voice-option-<id>, close-settings-button. Settings opens from BOTH orb-settings-button (route '/') and sidebar settings-link (route '/chat').
rca of the issue: No bugs found. All iteration-4 additions work end-to-end. Prime Directives are correctly injected at top of system prompt and obeyed by claude-sonnet-4-6. MFCC voiceprint enrolment, multi-embedding update (re-enroll), cosine-sim identification with 0.88 threshold, list with memory_count, and cascading delete (speaker + tagged memories) all verified. Per-person memory scope is enforced — speaker-tagged facts do not leak into owner scope and vice versa.
